data.title: Payment reminder for Noah's returned music lesson fees (June & July 2025)
data.summary: Musikschule Klangfarbe Musterlingen gGmbH sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) because the direct debits for Noah's June and July 2025 tuition fees were returned by the bank; they ask for the total outstanding amount of €123.00 (fees plus €7.00 bank charges) by 20 August 2025.
data.explanation: The music school tried to collect June and July's lesson fees by direct debit, but your bank returned both payments, so the school now also charges €7.00 in bank fees. The total owed is €123.00, due by 20 August 2025 — transfer this to the account shown to avoid further reminders. From September they plan to resume collecting the regular fee by direct debit as usual, so make sure your account can cover it; if your bank details have changed, tell them beforehand so the debit doesn't fail again.
